sources.quote: Since 2024, Russian national Ilya Aleksandrovich Boykov (Boykov) has actively supported Alis by exchanging and converting an equivalent of $3.5 million in cryptocurrency transactions, monitoring cryptocurrency transactions, and providing logistical support for Alis.

notes: This is Treasury’s official assessment, not a criminal adjudication.
